headline: AI retranslation + Freedomuniverse fixes
summary: Retranslated game dialog using a current AI model with better context handling, imported Freedomuniverse's friend-code crash fix, and repaired 18 broken menus / text-overrun bug-info screens. Most of the work in v2.2 is byte-level (terminator patches in the friend-code path); only a handful of msg entries show row-level changes, most of them the bug-book menus.

msgFileEdits.description: Every msg/onemsg .ofs sub-entry whose text differs between v2.1 and v2.2. Includes new translations (where the previous version still had Japanese or no English) and rewrites (where the English text was changed). Tags like [NPC:1009], [PLAYER_NAME], ▼ (line break), and § (page break) are wire-format control codes — they're shown verbatim, the diff just surfaces the surrounding text changes.
